name: Master Gadrin
summary: In Sen'jin Village, Master Gadrin guides the Darkspear through exile and loss. The elder witch doctor once trained the tribe's priests and mages with Zalazane. Now he helps his people and seeks to break the dark curse over their home on the Echo Isles.

sections.title: Mentor of the Darkspear
sections.body: Before the Darkspear reached Kalimdor, Master Gadrin guided generations of his people in the South Seas. He served as a witch doctor on the islands they called home, teaching the tribe's mystical ways.

sections.title: The Betrayal of Zalazane
sections.body: On the Echo Isles, Master Gadrin and the young witch doctor Zalazane trained the tribe's priests and mages together. Zalazane fell under the pull of the dark voodoo he sought to wield, and madness took hold. He enslaved the minds of his people and drove Vol'jin and the uncorrupted Darkspear onto the mainland of Durotar. Now in Sen'jin Village, Gadrin bears the grief of watching a companion become a tyrant. He works to lay slain tribesfolk to rest and end Zalazane's rule.

sections.title: Keeper of Ancient Lore
sections.body: Master Gadrin knows more of troll spiritualism and loa lore than almost anyone alive in the Horde. Scholars, shamans, and the Royal Apothecary Society seek his counsel on arcane and alchemical mysteries. When the Burning Blade threatens Durotar, or distant researchers need forgotten rites, Gadrin draws on what he knows. He can decipher the ancient tablets of Zul'Farrak and invoke Shadra the spider loa, then craft the bindings such a rite requires.

faq.answer: Master Gadrin guides the Darkspear as a witch doctor and elder spiritual leader. He lives in Sen'jin Village on Durotar's coast and advises Chieftain Vol'jin.

faq.q: What is Gadrin's history with Zalazane?
faq.answer: Master Gadrin and the young witch doctor Zalazane once trained the Darkspear's priests and mages on the Echo Isles. Gadrin watched Zalazane fall to dark magic, lose his reason, and drive the tribe from its island home.

faq.q: Why is Gadrin staying in Sen'jin Village?
aliases: what is gadrin doing in senjin village
faq.answer: Master Gadrin remains in Sen'jin Village, the refuge the survivors built on Durotar's southern coast after Zalazane's curse drove them from the Echo Isles. He counsels refugees, watches for local threats, and directs strikes against Zalazane's forces.

Minshina was Master Gadrin's brother. He died amid the turmoil on the Echo Isles, and his restless spirit began calling to Gadrin in dreams. Gadrin asks trusted adventurers to recover his brother's skull so Minshina's soul can find peace.

faq.q: Does Gadrin help with the Burning Blade cult?
faq.answer: Yes. After Zureetha Fargaze reports the Burning Blade's infiltration of the Valley of Trials, Master Gadrin watches for the cult near Sen'jin Village. Seeing the danger to Durotar, he sends recruits north to report to Orgnil Soulscar in Razor Hill.

faq.q: What does Gadrin know about the loa Shadra?
faq.answer: Master Gadrin knows the old teachings of troll theology. When the Forsaken Apothecary Lydon seeks a potent venom used by the Hinterlands Witherbark trolls, Gadrin identifies it as a gift from Shadra the spider loa. He sends adventurers to Zul'Farrak to read the tablet bearing her true name, which he needs to write a summoning spell.

angles.text: As a Darkspear troll, you have in Master Gadrin a living link to your ancestral home and Sen'jin's traditions. He has shaped your tribe's spiritual leaders for generations and grieves like a father over the tragedy of the Echo Isles.
As a priest, you share traditions Master Gadrin taught the Darkspear: communion with spirits and the loa, shaped by the shadow and faith of jungle trolls.
As a mage, you follow a path Master Gadrin opened by teaching the Darkspear arcane arts after the Third War. His teaching showed troll magic could reach beyond raw ritual mojo.
As a member of the Horde, you can look to Master Gadrin as one of Vol'jin's most trusted advisors. He watches coastal Durotar and warns Razor Hill when dark cults threaten Durotar's young nation.
